puffy (inflated in shape, as if filled with air; pillow-like)

o.text: From Proto-Turkic *sīĺč- (“to swell”), whence also şişmək.
Inherited from Early Old Oghuz سِكِشْ (sikiš). By surface analysis, sik- + -iş.
From Ottoman Turkish سونكر (sünger), from Medieval Greek σφουγγάριον (sphoungárion).
